scope: AUTO jobs033-044, precomputed-routing045-052, and eager-prefill053 repeat1 only; independent local raw parsing and pooling. No remote/source/runtime changes.

methods.pooling: Exact phase/EP/communication/capacity/N/variant repeats each contribute 100 untrimmed rank-MAX CUPTI samples. Median of concatenated 200; all repeat medians, pooled medians, Split/Mega ratios and signed changes compare exactly with JSON and CSV. No prefill pooling.
methods.signed_change: 100*(Mega_us/Split_us-1); negative is lower observed Mega latency. Extension/default comparison is computed independently for each arm, not confused with cross-backend ratio.
methods.autotune: 12 separate single-N process invocations, one initially absent private knobs.json each. Every invocation enumerates 8 candidates (2 group hints x2 tile N x2 token-back modes) with in_kernel_fc2_reduce=false. All-rank tactic records match the sole cache entry and printed winning candidate.
methods.autotune_score: Untimed search uses 3 eager preparation forwards, 6 untimed graph replays and 10 event-timed replays per candidate; score is maximum across ranks of each rank median. It times the Mega full-forward wrapper on staged hot inputs, excluding benchmark routing. This score is not the later cold-L2 CUPTI 100-sample benchmark and is not substituted for it.
methods.default: With private knob cache initially absent and no Mega tuning requested, source resolves the pinned built-in BF16/NVFP4 profile. Tile [256,128,256], group512, stages3 (None resolves to3), epi_warps, external FC2 reduction. AUTO winner tile [256,64,256], stages2 everywhere; group1024 except EP8/N1024 group512 in both repeats. Split retains its own existing tuning in both default and AUTO jobs.
methods.routing: Routing-only extension computes pinned SGLang route outside timed run_once for both arms; live-routing core includes route(). Expert precision/finalization, shape, capacity, source and per-path gate remain source-bound.
methods.prefill: job053 is eager, no graph argv/records/lifecycle request; per-path eager checks pass, four100-sample records retained as repeat1 and summary pooled=null.
methods.input_boundary: Input-contract and oracle execution verified by bound logs/source; input/output tensors, per-rank timing arrays and mapping tensors are not serialized here.

limitations: Only 20 completed extension jobs plus the first eager-prefill invocation; entire60-job study incomplete. Newly audited 18 pooled groups plus two single-repeat prefill points.
Native cross-pair FAIL remains visible. Per-path and same-backend graph acceptance do not establish backend equality.
No numerical checks of the100timed replays; graph cases have two poisoned untimed replays, eager prefill has no graph check requested.

Core-versus-AUTO uses separate single-N processes versus a multi-N core process; tuning/compile/allocator/cache history can differ. No isolated causal attribution or statistical significance from two repeats.
Precomputed routing comparison is a benchmark timed-scope ablation, not serving causality or an end-to-end serving speedup.
Autotune event scores are tuning evidence only, not CUPTI performance samples; knob cache key records capacity rather than the exact live N, hence per-N isolation is essential.
Logged rank-MAX arrays are source-bound; lack of serialized individual rank arrays/tensors prevents independent local reconstruction of their reduction or oracle tensors.

Candidate per-rank event arrays are not serialized; candidate selection is checked against source policy, printed scores, cache entry and all-rank winner records, not reconstructed from event samples.

auto_control_drift.interpretation: Matched core and AUTO execute in different invocations and process histories. Split latency also changes materially, so the observed Mega delta cannot all be attributed to tuning.
